title: Busbar resistance with a bolt hole
pickerTitle: Busbar resistance with a bolt hole
line: A DC current-flow FEA study of a copper busbar strip with one bolt hole at 100 A.
description: DC current flow in a copper busbar strip, 200 x 30 x 3 mm, with a 9 mm bolt hole at its middle. 100 A flows end to end. The study returns the potential, the current density, the voltage across the strip, which gives its resistance, and the current crowding beside the hole.
thumbnailAlt: Current density crowding beside the bolt hole of a copper busbar strip, solved in RunMat
